_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Saturday April 18th | 5:49 a.m 

Bonjour Tremblant!

It's the final weekend of the season, and what a way to close it out! Temperatures will climb early to near 20°C under a sunny morning sky, though clouds are expected to roll in through the afternoon. That said, strong winds with gusts up to 47 km/h are in the forecast, so even with the warm weather, make sure to bring an extra layer! Conditions are also variable across the mountain, with snow coverage and quality shifting throughout the day as temperatures rise. As a result, a few runs will also open progressively throughout the morning as our team assesses conditions on the mountain. Stay aware of your surroundings and ski safe! 

Finally, don't miss the Corona Summit Party today from 12:00 to 16:00 at the top of the mountain, with music, BBQ, and games to celebrate the end of an incredible season. 
Major lifts will be running until 16h30, so take full advantage of this last spring skiing weekend. Also please note that the Porte du Soleil, Casino Express, and Edge lifts are closed for the season. 

See you out there! 

Mountain safety tip of the week: Assist Ski Patrol.
If you witness or are involved in an accident, remain at the scene and provide your identification to ski patrol.
When you see our patrollers or safety staff responding on the slopes, slow down and make sure to give them space by staying at least 5 metres away from the incident area.

Snow fall is recorded daily at 5 a.m from mid-mountain at North Side (550 m / 1,800 ft). This data, based on 24 hours, provides a picture of on-mountain conditions. Actual accumulation may differ from the official report. Be aware of changing conditions. Lifts and trails exist in a mountain environment and may close due to weather, usage and/or special maintenance.
